description: Say you are still on what you hold, with a one-line note the hub shows. 30 minutes without one marks it stalled. If the answer says you no longer hold it, stop.

cwd.description: the worktree you are working in; default is the server's cwd

id.description: the id of what you hold

note.description: one plain sentence in the first person, as you would tell the person: "Reading the settings page to find where the toggle goes." Start it with BLOCKED: when you are stopped and need an answer

name: progress
title: Report progress
